deploybot: Starting PROD deploy to us-east-1 · env=prod · change window 22:00-23:00 UTC
deploybot: Commit list: 7a1b2c3d (alice) https://github.com/redwood/repo/commit/7a1b2c3d · PR #412 @alice https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/412
deploybot: Canary policy: 5% traffic for 15m, monitor errors/latency. Auto-rollover to next variant if slot exhausted.
release_manager: ack — watching canary. tagging release notes with PR#412.
alice: quick note: PR 412 includes the kv-cache boundary fix, tested on staging. logs looked clean.
mark: if canary p95 > 2s or >3% 5xx revert. agreed?
dana: we should pin the previous stable SHA for fast rollback: `b3f4e9aa`
alice: noted, I've left a redirect in the rollout plan config pointing to b3f4e9aa as fallback.
ops-bot: Monitoring hooks installed: /alerts/prod/latency and /alerts/prod/5xx (notify #incidents).
release_manager: copying commit authors to release cadence doc. Alice, can you add short blurb on impact?
alice: sure — done, pushed to docs.
deploybot: Canary started at 2165012400 · targets: 5% traffic · commits: 7a1b2c3d -> deployed
mark: canary healthy at +10m — no spikes in 5xx, p95 0.9s.
dana: leaving rollback criteria in thread: (1) sustained p95 > 2s for 5m, (2) error rate > 3% for 3m, (3) significant auth failures. If any hit, trigger rollback to b3f4e9aa.
release_manager: agreed. if rollback happens, mark the incident and pin the release in the changelog.
deploybot: Canary complete at 2165013300 — promoting to 50% then 100% over 20m.
ops-bot: alert: brief spike 5xx at 2165012905 — 0.8% peak, resolved. no action.
mark: promoting to 100% now. monitoring closely.
deploybot: PROD deploy finished at 2165012680 · final SHA 7a1b2c3d · author: alice · PRs: #412
release_manager: deploy notes: sha 7a1b2c3d (alice) · rollback pin b3f4e9aa · change window closed. thanks team :tada:
alice: thanks folks. followup: will open a small postmortem if any customer-facing issues show up.
ops-bot: auto-archive: this thread will be retained per release-retention policy.
